## AI Jobs Market 2025-2026 | Salaries, Skills & Demand

### About This Dataset
A comprehensive dataset of 1,500 AI and machine learning job
postings from 2025-2026, covering 25 roles across 14 countries.
Built for data scientists, ML engineers, students, and career
researchers who want to understand the rapidly evolving AI job
market — salaries, in-demand skills, remote work trends, and
company size breakdowns.

This is one of the most detailed AI-specific jobs datasets on
Kaggle — covering emerging roles like LLM Engineer, RAG
Engineer, AI Agent Developer, and Prompt Engineer that don't
exist in older job datasets.

---

### Coverage
- 1,500 job postings (2025-2026)
- 25 distinct AI/ML job roles
- 14 countries: USA, UK, Germany, France, Canada,
  Australia, Singapore, Switzerland, UAE, Japan,
  Netherlands, China, India, Remote/Global
- 12 industries: Technology, Finance, Healthcare,
  Automotive, Retail, Manufacturing and more
- 5 company sizes: Startup to Big Tech (FAANG+)

---

### Column Descriptions

| Column | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `job_id` | Unique job posting identifier |
| `job_title` | Specific AI/ML role title |
| `job_category` | Role category (AI Engineering, Data Science, etc.) |
| `experience_level` | Entry / Mid / Senior / Lead |
| `years_of_experience` | Required years of experience |
| `education_required` | Minimum education level required |
| `annual_salary_usd` | Annual salary in USD |
| `salary_min_usd` | Minimum salary range for role |
| `salary_max_usd` | Maximum salary range for role |
| `city` | Job location city |
| `country` | Job location country |
| `remote_work` | On-site / Hybrid / Fully Remote |
| `company_size` | Startup / SME / Mid-size / Enterprise / Big Tech |
| `industry` | Industry sector of hiring company |
| `required_skills` | Pipe-separated list of required skills |
| `ai_salary_premium_pct` | Salary premium % vs non-AI equivalent role |
| `demand_score` | Market demand score 0-100 for this role |
| `demand_growth_yoy_pct` | Year-over-year demand growth (%) |
| `benefits_score_10` | Benefits package quality score (0-10) |
| `posting_year` | Year job was posted (2025 or 2026) |
| `posting_month` | Month job was posted |
| `is_senior` | 1 if Senior or Lead level role |
| `is_remote_friendly` | 1 if Hybrid or Fully Remote |
| `is_llm_role` | 1 if role involves LLM/GenAI work |
| `salary_tier` | Entry / Mid / Upper-Mid / Senior / Elite |

---

### Key Findings

- **Highest paying role:** AI Solutions Architect
  averaging $251,577/year
- **Most in-demand role:** LLM Engineer with
  demand score of 98/100
- **Remote premium:** Fully Remote roles pay
  5-8% more than equivalent on-site positions
- **Big Tech premium:** FAANG+ pays 35% more
  than mid-size companies for same role
- **Fastest growing:** AI Agent Developer and
  RAG Engineer — both new roles in 2025-2026
- **USA dominates:** Average AI salary $226,190
  vs $25,000-$35,000 in India/China

---

### Suggested ML Tasks
- Salary prediction using regression models
- Role classification from required skills (NLP)
- Remote work salary premium analysis
- Clustering roles by skill requirements
- Time series analysis of AI hiring trends
- Geographic salary gap analysis

---

### Questions to Explore
- Which skills command the highest salary premium?
- Is a PhD worth it for AI roles?
- Do startups pay competitively vs Big Tech?
- Which country offers the best AI salary adjusted
  for cost of living?
- Are LLM roles replacing traditional ML roles?
- What's the salary difference between on-site
  and remote AI jobs?

---

### Data Sources
Compiled from publicly available salary reports
and job market research (2025-2026):
- Ravio Global Salary Benchmark 2026
- Robert Half Technology Salary Guide 2026
- Motion Recruitment AI/ML Salary Report 2025
- LinkedIn Workforce Insights 2025-2026
- Glassdoor AI Role Salary Data 2025

*Note: Salaries reflect USD-equivalent compensation.
Individual salaries may vary by negotiation,
location cost of living, and specific company.*
